recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a realistic photographic portrait of a bearded man in the foreground, juxtaposed against a stylized, hand-drawn comic-book illustration of a crowded bar interior illuminated by a glowing cyan neon sign.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground photographic realism vs. background illustrative stylization
Cool cyan neon lighting vs. warm orange interior glow
Large-scale display typography integrated as a physical neon object
Dense cross-hatching in the illustration vs. smooth gradients in the portrait
coreInvariants: Cyan neon glow effect on all background surfaces
Heavy black ink outlines and cross-hatching in the bar scene
Asymmetrical balance with the portrait anchored to the right edge
High-saturation color palette restricted to cyan, orange, and deep navy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale photographic portrait cropped to the right third of the frame; illustrative bar scene occupies the remaining two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright cyan neon sign in the top-left quadrant acts as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the neon sign, moves down through the bar patrons, and exits through the large portrait on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep navy/black space at the top and bottom edges provides breathing room for the dense central illustration.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Orange (Back-bar glow and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan light; high value contrast between the black ink and the neon glow.

letterConstructionRules: Double-line construction to mimic neon glass tubing
Integrated glow that bleeds into the surrounding background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminal of the 'S' extends into a decorative flourish
The 'L' and 'U' have blocky, square-serif characteristics

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated as a physical light source

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary hand-written script is used for small metadata labels on clothing or patches.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the physical light source aesthetic of the original.
Provides the structural weight needed for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a comic-book style illustration of a crowded bar interior with patrons at a counter. Use heavy black ink hatching and a color palette of deep navy and warm orange. Leave the right third of the frame for a photographic portrait. Add a large glowing cyan neon sign effect in the top left area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a high-resolution photographic portrait of a man on the right side. Add custom double-line neon lettering in cyan over the top-left section, ensuring the glow interacts with the background illustration.

verificationChecks: Does the neon sign appear to cast light on the bar patrons?
Is the contrast between the photographic portrait and the illustration sharp?
Is the cross-hatching texture visible in the shadows?
Does the lettering look like physical neon tubes?

adjustableVariables: Primary neon color (e.g., swapping cyan for pink)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portrait
Exact wording of the neon sign
Specific logos on hats or clothing

mustAchieve: Clean separation between foreground and background
avoid: Generic 'neon' filters that don't follow the tube structure
Overly clean digital lines without ink texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the neon glow is cyan and not white.
Check that the portrait does not have comic-style outlines.
Verify the background uses orange as a secondary light source.
Confirm the lettering is stacked and occupies the top-left quadrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Photographic Portrait] with [Comic-Style Background] using [Neon Signage] as the primary light source and [Cyan/Orange] as the core color contrast.
